title: Things to do in Atlanta tour by Luxury car
includes: Complimentary 'local' pick up and hotel pick up
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Travel through some historical locations & neighborhoods that defines the city of Atlanta. Some noteworthy Highlights include the site of the 1996 summer olympics, the world-renowned Mercedes-Benz stadium and the ever so popular Centennial Olympic Park (great for photos). We provide luxury cars with Local/knowledgeable guides as you embark on your journey through Atlanta. Get the proper introduction to Atlanta.
This is a private car tour that's perfect for locals and visitors alike.
